capabilities.description: Obligations engine: rules as data, fixed states, fail-closed owner view (D-062); no model

Task 2 retrieval v8 (interim candidate, D-102/D-106) for questions with no recorded answer: lexical search, provision map and expansion; never certifies completeness, so every answer is warned. Fails closed if its frozen code drifts

Source validity and conflict status per passage from the WS C validity 1.2 export (110 records, not independently verified legal content); current official links are shown, never fetched. A recorded answer citing an article recorded as repealed, amended or in conflict is withheld (rc3)
Personal-data intake gate (CR-29): pattern checks from the policy KB before any search or log
Per-response audit records on every owner channel: independent sanitizer, hash chain, reviewer-only view, fail closed
Error scenarios SC-1 to SC-3: synthetic events released one at a time and checked
VAT answers produced by claude-sonnet-5-5 in offline runs on 16 Oct 2026 and replayed only for an exactly matching question; no model is called at run time
Classifier outputs written by an independent agent for offline evaluation only; not model performance and not used by the app
Language model called at run time: none in Task 2 (D5e)
Reads the local knowledge base and fixtures; writes its own audit log. Does not browse, fetch sources, file, pay or send
Fictional businesses, TEST RULES, the simulated reviewer and the change replay; synthetic data only
Not built: live model answers, six-domain coverage, scheduled source monitoring, Arabic, real users, qualified tax review
